title: Declarative Automation: CLAUDE.md + Harness as Scheduler
desc: CLAUDE.md CronCreate declarations + harness auto-detection replaces custom scheduler. Recording execution in CLAUDE.md guarantees periodic execution without deployment.
steps: Add a CronCreate heading to CLAUDE.md under ## Nightly Schedules section with cron expression and durable=true flag for recurring execution.
The harness detects CronCreate(cron=...) headings at session start and schedules them automatically without additional deployment.
Run 'wkappbot cron list' to verify the scheduled tasks and their next execution times.
See skill-search-coverage-guide for coverage scoring rules.

requirements.cmd: grep '## Nightly Schedules' $(cd /d D:\GitHub\WKAppBot && echo CLAUDE.md)
